zh: 新增内置手机界面：抽屉侧栏、紧凑顶栏、可展开工具与独立统计区域；原生文本框保留中文组合输入、草稿、命令和附件，启用时关闭两个旧手机插件。
en: Built-in phone interface adds a drawer sidebar, compact header, expandable tools and separate statistics; native input preserves composition, drafts, commands and attachments. Disable the two previous phone plugins when enabling it.
